newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia TSUM ready to send SEC ADR papers.
newsitem.headline: Russia TSUM ready to send SEC ADR papers.

text.p: One of Russia's biggest retailers, OAO Torgovy Dom TSUM has prepared documents for Level-One American Depositary Receipts issue and will send them to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission next month, a spokeswoman for TSUM's financial adviser OLMA said on Thursday.
"Practically all the documents are ready and we shall send them to the Commission in mid-March," Svetlana Bik told Reuters.
She said the company was waiting for a suitable situation on the market and the completion of reconstruction of the fourth floor of its mall.
In December TSUM raised $10.83 million through a heavily oversubscribed share issue to help fund a $22 million reconstruction project.
